excerpt: A Complete Checklist for Newcomers to Canada: From Airport to Settlement Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. When it comes to bringing your spouse or common-law partner to Canada as a permanent resident, one of the first and most important decisions you’ll face is: Should you apply from inside or outside Canada? While both inland and outland spousal sponsorships aim to reunite families, they differ significantly in terms of processing time, eligibility, work permit access, and more. This blog breaks down the two options in 2025, helping you choose
